English.Char_Desc_45: Dock corner now playing companion for Mac
English.Char_Desc_80: Album artwork and dynamic color palette track title in the corner beside the Dock.
English.Char_Desc_250: Needle sits in the empty corner beside the macOS Dock, displaying high-res album covers with titles tinted in real-time by the artwork's dominant color palette. Supports Spotify and Apple Music.
English.Char_Desc_2000: Needle is the musical companion for macOS. Positioned in the corner opposite your Dock, it displays current playing tracks from Spotify, Apple Music, Podcasts, and web audio. Featuring real-time color extraction that tints interface typography to match cover art, Needle automatically disappears when playback pauses. Free, native Swift, open source under MIT.
